task.description:
Write specs and integration tests for ISS-501..504.

ISS-501 (tests/specs/ISS-501.md + tests/integration/iss501_storage_mode_test.zig):
TC1: LEGACY_RLS tenant → search_path=public, RLS active; TC2: SCHEMA tenant → search_path=tenant_{slug}; TC3: same tenant different modes → reads/writes hit expected store only

ISS-502 (tests/specs/ISS-502.md + tests/integration/iss502_spt_cutover_test.zig):
TC1: cutover copies all rows with parity; TC2: cutover flips storage_mode atomically; TC3: rollback on injected failure leaves tenant in LEGACY_RLS; TC4: re-run on SCHEMA tenant is no-op

ISS-503 (tests/specs/ISS-503.md + tests/integration/iss503_rls_removal_test.zig):
TC1: guard blocks removal if LEGACY_RLS tenant exists; TC2: removal succeeds when all SCHEMA; TC3: after removal, no RLS policies or tenant_id predicates remain

ISS-504 (tests/specs/ISS-504.md + tests/integration/iss504_migration_tracking_test.zig):
TC1: public.schema_migrations has GBL- entries; TC2: new tenant gets per-tenant schema_migrations; TC3: per-tenant migration ledger records applied versions

All: real PostgreSQL, per-test UUIDs, no mocks, no Error.SkipZigTest.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 spec files cover listed test cases
